definition_en: Confident and direct in stating opinions or claiming what one wants.
example_en: She was assertive in the meeting and clearly stated what she needed.
example_uz: U yig'ilishda dadil edi va nimaga muhtojligini aniq bildirdi.

definition_en: In a confident and direct way when stating opinions or needs.
example_en: He spoke assertively without being rude to his colleagues.
example_uz: U hamkasblariga qo'pol bo'lmasdan dadil tarzda gapirdi.

definition_en: The quality of confidently expressing opinions and needs.
example_en: The training course focused on building assertiveness in the workplace.
example_uz: Trening kursi ish joyida dadillikni shakllantirishga qaratilgan edi.

definition_en: In a way that shows belief in one's own abilities.
example_en: She walked into the interview confidently and answered every question well.
example_uz: U ishonch bilan intervyuga kirdi va har bir savolga yaxshi javob berdi.

definition_en: Charming and attracting attention or interest.
example_en: The lecturer had an engaging style that kept students interested.
example_uz: Ma'ruzachi talabalarni qiziqtiradigan uslubga ega edi.

definition_en: In a way that attracts and holds someone's attention or interest.
example_en: The author wrote engagingly about a subject most people find dull.
example_uz: Muallif ko'pchilik zerikarli deb hisoblaydigan mavzu haqida qiziqarli tarzda yozdi.

definition_en: To stop being involved with something, or to release a mechanism.
example_en: He decided to disengage from the argument before it got worse.
example_uz: U vaziyat yomonlashishidan oldin bahsdan chetlashishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: Not involved or interested in something happening around one.
example_en: Many students seemed disengaged during the online classes.
example_uz: Ko'plab talabalar onlayn darslarda beparvo ko'rinishardi.

definition_en: Giving someone a strong reason or incentive to do something.
example_en: The coach gave a motivating speech before the final match.
example_uz: Murabbiy final o'yinidan oldin ilhomlantiruvchi nutq so'zladi.

definition_en: Not having received much formal schooling or training.
example_en: His uneducated guess turned out to be surprisingly accurate.
example_uz: Uning bilimsiz taxmini kutilmaganda aniq bo'lib chiqdi.

definition_en: In a way that provides useful facts or knowledge.
example_en: The guide spoke informatively about the history of the museum.
example_uz: Gid muzey tarixi haqida ma'lumot beruvchi tarzda gapirdi.

definition_en: Lacking knowledge or information about a particular subject.
example_en: It's easy to make uninformed decisions without checking the facts.
example_uz: Faktlarni tekshirmasdan xabardor bo'lmagan qarorlar qabul qilish oson.

definition_en: To give someone false or inaccurate information, often unintentionally.
example_en: The article misinformed readers about the actual cost of the project.
example_uz: Maqola o'quvchilarga loyihaning haqiqiy narxi haqida noto'g'ri ma'lumot berdi.

definition_en: Having a strong and lasting influence on someone's development or character.
example_en: Her formative years were spent in a small village in the mountains.
example_uz: Uning shaxsini shakllantirgan yillari tog'lardagi kichik qishloqda o'tgan.

definition_en: Relating to the direction in which something moves or points.
example_en: The airport uses directional signs to help passengers find their gates.
example_uz: Aeroport yo'lovchilarga darvozalarini topishda yordam berish uchun yo'nalish belgilaridan foydalanadi.

definition_en: Not aimed toward a particular purpose or target; lacking guidance.
example_en: The meeting felt undirected, with no clear agenda or goal.
example_uz: Yig'ilish aniq kun tartibi yoki maqsadsiz, yo'naltirilmagandek tuyuldi.

definition_en: Not confident about oneself; lacking a feeling of safety.
example_en: Teenagers often feel insecure about their appearance.
example_uz: O'smirlar ko'pincha o'z tashqi ko'rinishiga ishonchsiz his qilishadi.

definition_en: In a way that shows a lack of confidence or safety.
example_en: The ladder was insecurely fastened to the wall and began to slip.
example_uz: Narvon devorga ishonchsiz o'rnatilgan edi va sirg'ana boshladi.

definition_en: A feeling of anxiety or lack of confidence about oneself.
example_en: His constant need for approval came from deep insecurity.
example_uz: Uning doimiy tasdiqlanishga bo'lgan ehtiyoji chuqur ishonchsizlikdan kelib chiqqan.

definition_en: Having too much confidence in one's own abilities, often unwisely.
example_en: The team lost because they became overconfident after an early lead.
example_uz: Jamoa erta gol tufayli ortiqcha o'ziga ishongani sababli mag'lub bo'ldi.

definition_en: Excessive belief in one's own abilities, often leading to poor judgment.
example_en: Overconfidence led the investors to ignore obvious warning signs.
example_uz: Ortiqcha o'ziga ishonch investorlarni ochiq ogohlantiruvchi belgilarni e'tiborsiz qoldirishga olib keldi.

definition_en: Willing to accept behavior or opinions different from one's own.
example_en: A good teacher is tolerant of different learning styles.
example_uz: Yaxshi o'qituvchi turli xil o'rganish uslublariga bag'rikeng bo'ladi.

definition_en: In a way that accepts behavior or beliefs different from one's own.
example_en: She listened tolerantly to opinions she strongly disagreed with.
example_uz: U keskin qarshi bo'lgan fikrlarni bag'rikenglik bilan tingladi.

definition_en: Not willing to accept views, behavior, or people that are different.
example_en: He is intolerant of any criticism of his work.
example_uz: U o'z ishiga bo'lgan har qanday tanqidga bag'rikeng emas.

definition_en: In a way that refuses to accept different views or behavior.
example_en: The manager reacted intolerantly to any suggestion of change.
example_uz: Menejer har qanday o'zgarish taklifiga bag'rikeng bo'lmagan holda javob berdi.

definition_en: Unwillingness to accept views, beliefs, or people that are different from one's own.
example_en: The festival was created to fight racial intolerance in the city.
example_uz: Festival shahardagi irqiy bag'rikenglik yo'qligiga qarshi kurashish uchun tashkil etilgan.

definition_en: In a way that is good enough to be approved of or allowed.
example_en: The project was completed acceptably, though not perfectly.
example_uz: Loyiha mukammal bo'lmasa-da, qoniqarli tarzda yakunlandi.

definition_en: Not satisfactory or allowed; not able to be accepted.
example_en: Such rude behavior is unacceptable in this workplace.
example_uz: Bunday qo'pol xatti-harakat bu ish joyida maqbul emas.

definition_en: To a degree that is not satisfactory or allowed.
example_en: Response times at the clinic were unacceptably slow.
example_uz: Klinikadagi javob berish vaqti maqbul bo'lmagan darajada sekin edi.

definition_en: Feeling or showing gratitude or pleasure in response to something.
example_en: The audience was appreciative and applauded for several minutes.
example_uz: Tomoshabinlar minnatdorchilik bildirib, bir necha daqiqa qarsak chalishdi.

definition_en: In a way that shows gratitude or pleasure.
example_en: She nodded appreciatively after tasting the meal her friend cooked.
example_uz: U do'sti pishirgan taomni tatib ko'rgach, minnatdorchilik bilan bosh irg'adi.

definition_en: Not recognized or valued for one's efforts or qualities.
example_en: She felt unappreciated after years of hard work went unnoticed.
example_uz: Yillar davomida qilgan mehnati sezilmagach, u o'zini qadrlanmagandek his qildi.

definition_en: In a way that adds significant worth or usefulness.
example_en: The volunteers contributed valuably to the community project.
example_uz: Ko'ngillilar jamoat loyihasiga foydali tarzda hissa qo'shishdi.

definition_en: Extremely useful; too valuable to be measured.
example_en: Her advice was invaluable when I was starting my own business.
example_uz: O'z biznesimni boshlaganimda uning maslahati bebaho edi.

definition_en: To reduce the value or worth of something, or to reduce a currency's exchange rate.
example_en: The central bank decided to devalue the national currency.
example_uz: Markaziy bank milliy valyutani qadrsizlantirishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: To consider something to be worth more than it actually is.
example_en: Investors tend to overvalue companies during periods of market excitement.
example_uz: Investorlar bozor hayajoni davrida kompaniyalarni ortiqcha baholashga moyil bo'lishadi.

definition_en: To consider something to be worth less than it actually is.
example_en: Many companies undervalue the importance of good customer service.
example_uz: Ko'plab kompaniyalar yaxshi mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatishning ahamiyatini kam baholaydi.

definition_en: Thinking carefully about the feelings and needs of other people.
example_en: It was very considerate of you to save me a seat.
example_uz: Menga o'rin saqlab qo'yishingiz juda e'tiborli xatti-harakat edi.

definition_en: In a way that shows thought for other people's feelings and needs.
example_en: He considerately lowered his voice so as not to wake the baby.
example_uz: U chaqaloqni uyg'otmaslik uchun e'tiborli tarzda ovozini pasaytirdi.

definition_en: Not thinking about the feelings or needs of other people.
example_en: Parking in two spaces was pretty inconsiderate of other drivers.
example_uz: Ikkita joyga to'xtash boshqa haydovchilarga nisbatan juda e'tiborsizlik edi.

definition_en: In a way that shows no thought for other people's feelings or needs.
example_en: He inconsiderately played loud music late at night.
example_uz: U kechqurun kech vaqtda e'tiborsiz tarzda baland ovozda musiqa qo'ydi.

definition_en: To a large or noticeable degree; a lot.
example_en: Prices have risen considerably over the past year.
example_uz: Narxlar o'tgan yil davomida sezilarli darajada oshdi.

definition_en: Showing politeness and consideration toward someone.
example_en: Students should be respectful toward their teachers.
example_uz: Talabalar o'qituvchilariga hurmat ko'rsatishi kerak.

definition_en: In a way that shows politeness and consideration toward someone.
example_en: She respectfully disagreed with her manager's decision.
example_uz: U menejerining qaroriga hurmat bilan qarshi chiqdi.

definition_en: Showing a lack of respect or consideration for someone.
example_en: It's disrespectful to interrupt someone while they are speaking.
example_uz: Kimningdir gapini bo'lish hurmatsizlik hisoblanadi.

definition_en: In a way that shows a lack of respect or consideration for someone.
example_en: He spoke disrespectfully to the elderly customer.
example_uz: U keksa mijozga hurmatsiz tarzda gapirdi.

definition_en: Showing bravery, especially when facing danger or difficulty.
example_en: The firefighters made a courageous rescue from the burning building.
example_uz: O't o'chiruvchilar yonayotgan binodan jasurona qutqaruv ishlarini amalga oshirishdi.

definition_en: In a way that shows bravery when facing danger or difficulty.
example_en: She courageously spoke out against the unfair policy.
example_uz: U adolatsiz siyosatga qarshi jasurona ovoz ko'tardi.

definition_en: Making someone feel less confident or hopeful about something.
example_en: The low test scores were discouraging for the whole class.
example_uz: Past test natijalari butun sinf uchun ruhni tushiruvchi edi.

definition_en: Giving someone support, confidence, or hope about something.
example_en: The doctor's report was encouraging; the treatment was working.
example_uz: Shifokorning hisoboti ilhomlantiruvchi edi; davolash samara berayotgan edi.

definition_en: In a number of different ways, at different times, or by different people.
example_en: The plan has been described variously as brilliant and reckless.
example_uz: Reja turlicha - ba'zan ajoyib, ba'zan esa beparvo deb ta'riflangan.

definition_en: Always, in every case; without exception.
example_en: He invariably arrives at the office before everyone else.
example_uz: U hamisha ofisga hammadan oldin keladi.

definition_en: Never changing; always the same in every case.
example_en: Her morning routine is almost invariable, day after day.
example_uz: Uning ertalabki tartibi kundan kunga deyarli o'zgarmasdir.

definition_en: In a way that shows no interest, concern, or preference.
example_en: He shrugged indifferently when asked about the result.
example_uz: Natija haqida so'ralganda u beparvo tarzda yelka qisdi.

definition_en: A lack of interest, concern, or sympathy toward something.
example_en: His indifference to the suffering of others shocked his friends.
example_uz: Uning boshqalarning azob-uqubatlariga nisbatan beparvoligi do'stlarini hayratga soldi.
